classification.difficultyReason: Use the supplied columns to calculate the frequency-weighted mean, then use that mean for deviations and weighted squares before dividing by total frequency and taking the square root.

inlines.text: Complete the following extended frequency table to calculate the mean and standard deviation of the given data set. Give answers correct to two decimal places unless otherwise specified.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\sum f_i&=2+7+6+1+2+2=20\\\sum f_ix_i&=2+14+18+4+10+12=60\\\bar{x}&=\frac{60}{20}=3\end{align*}$$
The deviations are $-2,-1,0,1,2,3$. The weighted squared deviations are $8,7,0,1,8,18$, respectively.
$$\begin{align*}\sum f_i(x_i-\bar{x})^2&=8+7+0+1+8+18=42\\\sigma&=\sqrt{\frac{42}{20}}\\\sigma&=\sqrt{2.1}\\\sigma&\approx1.45\end{align*}$$
